title: Mafia Mod
description: Role-playing detective event "Mafia Has No Place Here"
body:
# Mafia Mod — Classic Mafia Game in Minecraft!

Want to play Mafia with your friends right on your Minecraft server? This mod brings the full classic Mafia party game experience, a user-friendly interface, and tons of fun!

## Features:
- 🕵️‍♂️ **Roles:** Mafia, Detective, Doctor, Villager, Host — each with unique objectives.
- 🌗 **Game Phases:** Day (discussion and voting for exile) and Night (Mafia selects a victim, Detective investigates, Doctor can save a player).
- 👑 **Host:** Manages the game, does not participate in voting or target selection, receives special notifications.
- 🗳️ **Voting:** Convenient interface for voting and target selection with interactive buttons and colored messages.
- 💬 **Titles and Notifications:** Each player receives private messages about their role and the results of night and day phases.
- 👥 **Lobby System:** Create lobbies, invite friends, join and leave games with a single click.
- 🚫 **Restrictions:** Dead players and the host cannot be selected as targets; the host does not participate in voting.
- 🧹 **Chat Clearing:** The chat is cleared for all participants at the start of each game.
- ⚡ **Automatic Game Start and End:** Everything is fast and seamless!
- 🔒 **Player Limit:** Up to 10 players per game.

## How to start a game:
1. Create a lobby and invite your friends.
2. Assign a host.
3. Start the game and follow the chat prompts.
4. Enjoy classic Mafia gameplay right in Minecraft!

## Compatibility:
- Requires Minecraft Forge.
- Only Forge servers are supported (Fabric is not supported).
- Recommended Minecraft versions: 1.21.4.

## Installation:
1. Install Forge for your Minecraft version.
2. Download the mod and place the file into the `mods` folder.
3. Launch the game and configure settings as you like!

**Dive into the world of Mafia right in Minecraft and test your deduction skills!**
